protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-22 residual of SECURITY-3672. Source is attacker-controlled FileCredentials.getFileName() supplied to FileBinding.write / ZipFileBinding.write. Incomplete sanitization at BIC 3f6decef43ea5eebde2251ec5ea81b7eeeaa21ed uses controller-local java.io.File.getName(), which on Unix does not treat backslash as a separator, then hudson.FilePath.child(baseName) on the node. FilePath.resolvePathIfRelative converts '\' to '/' on Unix and FilePath.normalize() collapses '..' across both separators, so payloads such as '..\\..\\p0wn3d.txt' escape UnbindableDir (WorkspaceList.tempDir secrets directory) and copyFrom/unzipFrom write or extract outside that directory. Vendor https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2026-05-27/#SECURITY-3790 and CVE.org CVE-2026-48922 (state PUBLISHED) confirm arbitrary node-filesystem writes and possible RCE when a low-privileged user can supply file/zip credentials to a job on the built-in node. Direct fix e52b2328afdebcb69852687392fde94b174eaec4 switches to new FilePath(new File(...)).getName(), whose getName() splits on both '/' and '\\'.
